newsitem.title: USA: CHINA CONTINENTAL SEES 97 REVS NEAR $45 ML.
newsitem.headline: CHINA CONTINENTAL SEES 97 REVS NEAR $45 ML.

text.p: China Continental Inc said Thursday that it expects fiscal 1997 revenues to approach $45 million, compared with the $38 million reported for fiscal 1996.

The company, which designs, installs and markets turnkey plastics production in the People's Republic of China, reported net income of $15 million, or $0.58 per share, for the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996.
It said this was a 28 percent increase over fiscal 1995's $11.7 million, or $0.45 per share.
Revenues for fiscal 1996 were $38.3 million, up from $32.6 million in 1995.

"China Continental's strong balance sheet will enable us to continue to grow our leading plastics manufacturing business in China, while pursuing additional growth markets for the company. We expect fiscal 1997 revenues to approach $45 million," a company statement said.

The company said it is seeking to diversify its activities through equity investments and that it is negotiating to increase its ownership in Weifang Great Dragon Chemical Fibre Co Ltd in the Shangdong Province of China. The company produces polyester tire cord fabrics and polyester nylon canvases.
China Continental said it is planning to apply for Nasdaq listing "as soon as practicable."
